title: Zephyr: Type 0x01 coords encode/decode
close_reason: Fixed: Added gateway_network_location_encode_announce_coords() function to network_location.c/h. The encode function mirrors the existing decode function: takes lat_e7/lon_e7 (int32_t) and writes 9-byte Type 0x01 app_data (type + lat_e7_be + lon_e7_be). Also added write_int32_be() helper to complement read_int32_be().
